implementation.name: JTFRAME
implementation.notes: JTFRAME is jotego's core framework; since the standalone jotego/jtframe repository was retired it lives at modules/jtframe inside jtcores. The CPU wrapper layer (modules/jtframe/hdl/cpu/jtframe_z80.v, jtframe_mos6502.v, jtframe_8751mcu.v, jtframe_i8742.v, jtframe_m68k.v, jtframe_sys6809.v, jtframe_6801mcu.v) adapts third-party CPU cores vendored in sibling directories, which is what the implementation_dependency rows record. License: https://github.com/jotego/jtcores/blob/master/modules/jtframe/LICENSE (GPLv3 text) plus the "or (at your option) any later version" grant in https://github.com/jotego/jtcores/blob/master/modules/jtframe/hdl/cpu/jtframe_z80.v. That license covers JTFRAME's own sources only; each vendored CPU directory carries its own terms (see the linked provider records). Platforms read from the directory listing of modules/jtframe/target: mist, mister, neptuno, pocket, sidi and sidi128 -- the last two map to the "other" platform row. accuracy_id omitted: a framework, not a chip model. No implementation_chip rows for the same reason.
